newsitem.title: USA: Dow retreats, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow retreats, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips slipped to stand nearly unchanged in late afternoon, prompting the NYSE to lift its program trading curbs.
The Dow industrials stood up five points at 7892, dipping below the 7900 mark for the first time this afternoon. The NYSE lifted index-arbitrage curbs at 1509 EDT/1909 GMT.
Bonds also backtracked from their highs. The benckmark 30-year U.S. Treasury was up 12/32 to yield 6.54 percent.
Tech stocks held to their solid gains, however, propelling Nasdaq eight points higher at 1499.
